Bash(powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "
if \(Test-Path ''C:\\Work\\AI_For_Supreme_Com\\bridge\\build\\supcom_llm_bridge.dll''\) {
    $f = Get-Item ''C:\\Work\\AI_For_Supreme_Com\\bridge\\build\\supcom_llm_bridge.dll''
    Write-Output \(''DLL size: '' + $f.Length + '' bytes''\)
    Write-Output \(''Created: '' + $f.LastWriteTime\)
    # Check PE magic
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($f.FullName\)
    $magic = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString\($bytes[0..1]\)
    Write-Output \(''PE magic: '' + $magic\)
    # Check machine type at offset PE+4 \(after 0x3c offset\)
    $peOffset = [System.BitConverter]::ToInt32\($bytes, 0x3c\)
    $machine = [System.BitConverter]::ToUInt16\($bytes, $peOffset + 4\)
    Write-Output \(''Machine type: 0x'' + $machine.ToString\(''X4''\) + '' \(0x014C=i386, 0x8664=x64\)''\)
} else {
    Write-Output ''DLL not found''
}
")
